messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Move to discourse? http://discourse.mc-stan.org
parts:
Hi all,

Can we move our discussions to http://discourse.mc-stan.org?
This requires everyone to:
1. Go to discourse.mc-stan.org and register
2. Let us know that you're registered and one of us can add you to the developers list.

We recently had emails about the new Stan meeting time that was sent to an ad-hoc list. Rather than creating a new Google group for just the meeting invitees, I propose we use discourse and add permissions to see information about the meeting.

To use the developers list on discourse, you can either:
1. Go to the website and use the interface there.
2. Email stan...@mc-stan.org (or mc_...@discoursemail.com). This will create a new thread with the developers category.



Daniel
